summary.whatChanges: Tightens the TypeScript signature of `ZodInstanceOf.properties()` so the shape must use keys that exist on the instance type, with schemas whose output is assignable to each property's type; method-valued keys are excluded from the allowed shape. A type test covers the new constraints.
behaviorChanges: `.properties()` on `z.instanceof(...)` now autocompletes keys from the instance type
Passing an unknown key (e.g. `nmae`) to `.properties()` is a compile-time error
Passing a schema of the wrong type for a property (e.g. `size: z.string()`) is a compile-time error
Keys whose values are functions/methods (e.g. `File.text`) are rejected in the shape
Narrowing a wider property with a literal schema still type-checks and is reflected in the inferred type
risks: Existing code that passed extra or loosely-typed keys to `z.instanceof().properties()` will now fail to compile
Excluding all function-typed keys prevents validating method properties even when intentional
Constraint uses `$ZodType<unknown, T[k]>`, so schemas whose output isn't exactly assignable to the property type may be rejected in edge cases (optional/readonly/index-signature members)
Runtime behavior is unchanged, so the stricter types could mismatch previously-working runtime usage
